title: Pocketwire Pay in 4 Terms on Rescheduling and Hardship
content:
## Pocketwire Pay in 4 — Changing the Payment Schedule

### 1. Moving a due date

1.1 Where the tier makes rescheduling available, one installment's due date can be moved up to the tier's maximum number of calendar days later.

1.2 A move is allowed only within the tier's number of reschedules on that plan and within the tier's number of reschedules per calendar year on the account, the yearly count being the reschedules recorded on the account with a date in the calendar year containing the day of handling.

1.3 A due date can be moved only before that installment is due: on a day before its due date, and not on or after it.

### 2. Hardship

2.1 A hardship pause stops every installment of the account for the tier's number of hardship pause days, at most the tier's number of hardship pauses per calendar year.

2.2 A hardship respread spreads one plan's remaining balance over the tier's number of extra installments.

2.3 Both rest on the verified customer's statement of a loss of income or an emergency expense.

### 3. Amount owed

3.1 A schedule change never changes the amount owed.

### Schedule of allowances

| Tier | Rescheduling | Most days a due date can move | Reschedules per plan | Reschedules per calendar year | Hardship pause (calendar days) | Hardship pauses per calendar year | Extra installments on a hardship respread |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | Not available | 0 | 0 | 0 | 14 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | Available | 7 | 1 | 2 | 14 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | Available | 7 | 1 | 3 | 14 | 1 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | Available | 14 | 1 | 4 | 21 | 1 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | Available | 14 | 2 | 6 | 21 | 1 | 4 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | Available | 14 | 2 | 8 | 30 | 1 | 4 |

The allowances apply according to the tier the account is on. On Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter and Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic the respread allowance is 0 extra installments.

### How a change is recorded

Each schedule change is recorded against the plan with its kind — a reschedule, a hardship pause or a hardship respread — the first installment it affects, the date of the change and the new due date of that installment. After a respread, installments are numbered beyond the plan's original number. The yearly counts are kept by kind: reschedules count towards the reschedule allowances, hardship pauses towards the hardship pause allowance.

### Cases (hypothetical installment due on day 28)

| Tier and history | Request made on | Change | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic, no earlier reschedule | Day 27 | Move to day 35 (7 days later) | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic, no earlier reschedule | Day 27 | Move to day 36 (8 days later) | No — more than 7 days |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic, no earlier reschedule | Day 28 | Any move | No — the installment is already due |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic, one reschedule already on this plan | Day 20 | Move to day 30 | No — plan allowance of 1 used |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier, one reschedule on this plan, three this year | Day 20 | Move to day 42 (14 days later) | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | Day 20 | Any move | No — not available |

A hardship pause on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred, resting on the verified customer's statement of a loss of income, stops every installment of the account for 21 calendar days; the amount owed stays exactly as it was.
